newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton falls, stocks pileup ahead of monsoon.
newsitem.headline: India cotton falls, stocks pileup ahead of monsoon.

text.p: Indian cotton prices eased on Monday as stocks piled up ahead monsoon rains expected soon, dealers said.
"Increased offerings by stockists prompted more arrivals of cotton in the open market while the demand remained dull at the higher level," one broker said.
He said the monsoon has commenced in parts of western India and would hit north India shortly.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi slid by 5/10 rupees at 1,045/1,090 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned fell by 10/25 rupees at 1,840/1,900 rupees per maund.

Gujarat Kalyan dropped by 100 rupees at 14,400/14,900 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton fell by 100 rupees at 13,300 rupees per candy and Kala-ginned fell by 100 rupees at 12,600 rupees per candy.
